descriptions.134: Update the aeneas flake input so the installed charon and aeneas (exposed as aeneas-charon/aeneas-aeneas via flake.nix and lib/mkHost.nix, installed in modules/home/packages/misc.nix) match the pin used by ~/Projects/Logos/Verification: aeneas 227f4e7ac70d687a6b1a4871b3304f5a1c6994bf, with charon a5591f6b94c8575a6ba2ae71090614a722f2b011 (the charon revision that aeneas pins). flake.lock currently locks aeneas at 86158eb2e18944c5225959712efb96bce188f40d and the installed charon reports b104e24, so Verification framed_channel/check.sh refuses to run with "the extraction's pinned revisions disagree". Pin aeneas.url to the exact revision (github:AeneasVerif/aeneas/227f4e7ac70d687a6b1a4871b3304f5a1c6994bf) rather than following the default branch, so future drift is deliberate; confirm the resulting charon matches a5591f6. Also consider adding hacl.cachix.org (key hacl.cachix.org-1:FzsZ2xsByOwKwIWNPII7yMOelJNDZ12mDAj3d1eGX0c=) as a trusted substituter in nix.settings so these packages are fetched instead of compiled from source (hours), and update the flake.nix comment that says no public binary cache exists. Acceptance: after rebuild, `aeneas --version`/`charon version` on PATH report the pinned revisions and Verification check.sh passes its aeneas revision coherence stage without a scratch Nix store.
